# Tela

> Tela is a desktop UI framework in pure Go (no cgo, no webview): React-style components and hooks, styled with Tailwind CSS v4 classes, drawn by its own renderer on Linux, Windows and macOS, and rendered headlessly to PNGs and aria snapshots so an agent can see what it built. This file is the core every agent reads: what every screen needs, an index of the recipes and the pitfalls. A question about one area (windows, forms and kit, animation, i18n, testing...) is answered by a recipe in `llms/`, listed under Recipes. Every Go block in this file and in the recipes compiles against the current API.

Contents: Start · The agent loop · Elements and props · Components and hooks · Styling · kit · Testing · Recipes · Pitfalls and limits

## Start

- Tela draws every pixel (like Flutter or a browser). There is no HTML, DOM, CSS file or JavaScript: a tree of Go values describes the UI.
- Elements and props come from package `h` (dot-imported, so markup reads like JSX); the app, hooks, events and colors from `tela`; ready-made styled components from `kit`.
- Components are struct values with a `Build() tela.Node` method, or functions wrapped in `tela.C`/`tela.CP`. Hooks (`tela.UseState`...) follow React's rules.
- Styling is `Class("...")` with Tailwind v4 class names, verbatim. Theme tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`) follow light and dark.
- Go 1.27+, always `CGO_ENABLED=0`. Lucide icons are a separate module.

```sh
mkdir myapp && cd myapp && go mod init example.com/myapp
go get github.com/kuronosu/tela@latest github.com/kuronosu/tela/icons/lucide@latest
CGO_ENABLED=0 go install github.com/kuronosu/tela/cmd/tela@latest   # the CLI: mcp, snapshot, inspect, check, verify, lint, dev, run, build
# or: tela new myapp  (a counter app with a test, go.mod ready)
go mod tidy   # after you add imports: kit and aria need golang.org/x/text
```

The imports of a screen:

```go
import (
	"github.com/kuronosu/tela"
	. "github.com/kuronosu/tela/h"
	"github.com/kuronosu/tela/kit"

	"github.com/kuronosu/tela/icons/lucide" // lucide.Check, lucide.Settings, ... (Lucide's file names in CamelCase)
)
```

The smallest complete app. `var App` is the window that `main` opens and the screen that `tela snapshot` and `tela mcp` render:

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/kuronosu/tela"
	. "github.com/kuronosu/tela/h"
	"github.com/kuronosu/tela/kit"
)

// Counter is the public name; tela.C gives counter its own hook state.
func Counter() tela.Node { return tela.C(counter) }

func counter() tela.Node {
	count, setCount := tela.UseState(0)
	return Div(Class("flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center"),
		kit.Card{
			Class:       "w-72",
			Title:       Text("Counter"),
			Description: Textf("Clicked %d times", count),
			Footer: kit.Button{Class: "w-full", Children: Text("Add one"),
				OnClick: func() { setCount.Update(func(n int) int { return n + 1 }) }},
		})
}

var theme = kit.Theme() // shadcn/ui's neutral colors and 10 px radius: use it with kit

var App = tela.App{
	Title: "Counter", Width: 480, Height: 320,
	Theme: &theme, RootClass: "bg-background text-foreground",
	Root: Counter(),
}

func main() { tela.Main(App) }
```

**What the CLI and `tela mcp` mount** (the package may be `main` or any package):

- `var Previews = tela.Previews{...}`: several named screens; `--preview NAME` (or the `open` tool) picks one, else the first name in byte order. Wins over the others.
- `func Preview() tela.Node`: one screen, mounted as `tela.C(Preview)`, so it may call hooks itself.
- Otherwise `var App = tela.App{...}`: its `Root` is the screen.
- In every case `var App` (a `tela.App` or `*tela.App`) gives the window: `Width`/`Height` (default 960x640), `RootClass`, `Theme`, `ColorScheme`, `ClassAliases`. Without `RootClass` the window is white with black text, and without `Theme: &theme` kit's radius is Tailwind's scale, not shadcn's 10 px.
- `tela.Preview{Root, Wrap, Theme, ColorScheme}` is one named screen: `Root` is any `tela.Component`; `Wrap func(tela.Node) tela.Node` (optional, no hooks) puts it inside the providers of the contexts it reads; `Theme` (a `*tela.Theme`) and `ColorScheme` (`tela.Light` or `tela.Dark`) win over the App's and over `--dark`, to show a screen under another theme. A preview has no size or state of its own: the size is `App` or `--size`, and the **initial state** comes from fields of a struct component.
- Leave `App.ColorScheme` as `tela.System` (the zero value): an explicit `tela.Light` or `tela.Dark` wins over the OS and over `--dark` (the CLI warns), so every render would have that scheme.

```go
// Several screens, each started in the state its fields give it.
var Previews = tela.Previews{
	"1 Empty": {Root: Inbox{}},
	"2 Full":  {Root: Inbox{Unread: 12}},
	"3 Open":  {Root: kit.Toaster{Children: Inbox{Unread: 3, Open: true}}},
}

// Unread and Open only choose the first state: the component owns it.
type Inbox struct {
	Unread int
	Open   bool
}

func (in Inbox) Build() tela.Node {
	open, setOpen := tela.UseState(in.Open)
	return Div(Class("p-8 text-sm"), Textf("%d unread", in.Unread),
		kit.Switch{Checked: &open, OnCheckedChange: setOpen.Set, AriaLabel: "Open"})
}
```

**State previews.** `tela snapshot` renders one frame, so to see an edited form, an error or a dialog, make a preview whose struct component has a field that chooses the initial `UseState` (`Start string`, `Scenario string`), and give each state its own name in `Previews`: `"1 Sign in"`, `"2 Invalid"`... so the first sorts first. To see below the fold, render taller: `tela snapshot --size 1100x1700 --preview "2 Invalid"`.

`tela.App` fields: `Title`, `AppID`, `Width`, `Height`, `RootClass`, `Root` (a `tela.Component`: `Settings()`, `Settings{}`, `kit.Toaster{Children: ...}`), `ColorScheme`, `Theme *tela.Theme`, `ClassAliases`, `ClassicScrollbars`, `InstantScroll`, `Dev *bool`; the window fields (`Frameless`, `Transparent`, `OnClose`...) are in the recipe windows. `tela.Main(app)` opens the window and runs until it closes; `tela.Run(app)` returns the error instead.

## The agent loop

Write the package, look at it, fix, repeat. `tela mcp` keeps a headless instance of the screen running and rebuilds it when the source changes.

```sh
claude mcp add tela -- tela mcp ./myapp          # Claude Code; other clients: {"command": "tela", "args": ["mcp", "./myapp"]}
tela mcp [--size WxH] [--scale N] [--dark] [--preview NAME] [pkg]
```

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `snapshot {}` | Aria snapshot (Playwright YAML): `[ref=eN]` on what you can act on, `[src=file:line]` where the source made it. Call it after every edit |
| `screenshot {}` / `{"ref": "e5"}` | PNG of window or element. Judge the look here |
| `click {"ref": "e5"}` | Click; `"button": "right"`, `"double": true`, or `"x"`, `"y"` |
| `fill {"ref": "e7", "text": "ana@example.com"}` | Set a field's value; `"submit": true` presses Enter |
| `press {"key": "Tab"}` | Key or combo in Playwright syntax (`Enter`, `Shift+Tab`, `Control+a`), optionally on a `ref` |
| `hover`, `scroll {"ref", "dy": 400}`, `drag {"from", "to" or "dx"/"dy"}` | Pointer moves, wheel (without ref: window center), drags |
| `resize {"width": 390, "height": 844}` / `{"scale": 2}` | Keeps the state; breakpoints follow |
| `open {"dark": true}` / `{"preview": "2 Full"}` | Mount afresh (state reset): dark mode, preview, size, scale; `{}` lists the previews |
| `wait {"ms": 500}` / `{"text": "Saved"}` | Advance the app clock (timers, animations, toasts) or wait for a text |
| `inspect {"ref": "e5"}` | Layout JSON: rects, spacing, classes, class errors, computed style, `src`. For misplaced boxes |
| `state {"ref"}`, `perf {"action": true}`, `logs {}`, `prefer {"reducedMotion": true}` | Why a component rendered (hooks, setter line); frame times; dev warnings; reduced motion, `textScale`, `locale`, `"direction": "rtl"`, `dark`, live |
| `lint {}` | `tela lint -json` on the package |
| `check {}` / `verify {}` | Audit the screen: cut-off or overlapping text, low contrast, small targets, missing names, focus. `check` in light and dark; `verify` every preview at several widths, large text, RTL and another language. **Run `check` before finishing UI work** |
| `film {"span": 600, "action": {...}}`, `test {}` | Frames of the motion an action starts; the session as a `telatest` test |

Name elements by `ref` (latest snapshot), or `role` + `name`, `text`, `testId`, with `nth`. A ref is the element itself (survives renames; "gone" once unmounted). Acting tools return the new snapshot.

**Reading a result.** The text has sections: `### Snapshot`, `### Dev errors` (unknown classes, "did you mean": fix first), `### Dev warnings`, `### Lint`, `### Output of the app`. A dev-mode panic is the call's error, with the fix in its message; the screen is mounted afresh. "The source changed: rebuilt ... (state reset)" means your edit is live. "The package does not compile:" lists the compiler's errors; the previous build keeps answering.

**A good loop.** 1) Write the screen with `var App` (or `Preview`). 2) `snapshot`: fix every dev error and lint finding. 3) `screenshot`: fix the look. 4) `open {"dark": true}` + `screenshot`. 5) `click`/`fill` the main interactions and `screenshot` the states (dialogs, toasts after `wait`). 6) `resize` to a narrow window. 7) `check`, and a `telatest` test of the main flow.

**CLI equivalents** (same rendering, deterministic, no system fonts):

```sh
tela snapshot --size 1040x800 --scale 2 --dark -o out.png ./myapp   # PNG (W*scale x H*scale); one frame: effects, timers and toasts do not show
tela inspect ./myapp            # aria snapshot YAML; --layout for the layout JSON
tela lint ./...                 # unknown classes, roles, aria tokens, keys, hook misuse, a prop where a node goes; file:line:col: rule: message
tela lint -fix ./...            # also removes redundant single-child Fragment(x) wrappers
tela check ./myapp              # audit one screen in light and dark; exit 1 with findings (file:line: rule (impact): message, then fix:)
tela verify ./myapp             # the same for every preview at 360, 768 and 1280 px, 2x text, RTL and another language
tela dev ./myapp                # a real window that reloads on save, keeping state (recipe dev)
tela run ./myapp [args]         # build and run the program; tela build -o dist ./myapp builds it
```

## Elements and props

An element takes props and children in one list, in any order: `Div(Class("p-4"), H2(Text("Title")), OnClick(f))`. A string is not a child: write `Div(Text("x"))` or `Textf("%d items", n)`.

**Elements:** `Div` (block box; the general container), `Span` (inline in text; a flex item inside `flex`), `P`, `H1`..`H6` (unstyled, like Tailwind's Preflight: size them with classes; they give heading roles), `Button` (no look of its own, focusable, Enter/Space click), `A` (`Href`; does not navigate: handle `OnClick`), `Strong`, `Em`, `Code`, `Img` (`SrcPath`, `SrcFS`, `SrcBytes`, `Src(image.Image)`, `Alt`; PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG), `Icon(icon, props...)` (an SVG `tela.Icon`, 1em, colored by the text color), `Input`, `Textarea`, `Form` (`OnSubmit`; Enter submits), `Label` (`For`), `Text`, `Textf`, `TextFn(func() string)`, `Fragment(children...)` (no box), `Portal(children...)` (a layer above the window: overlays), `Presence(children...)` (keeps exiting children mounted), `VirtualList`. There is no `Ul`, `Li`, `Nav`, `Section`, `Header`, `Table` or `Select` element: use `Div` with `Role("list")`, `Role("navigation")`... and `kit` components.

**Props:** `Class(classes...)`, `Style(tela.Width(w), tela.Bg(c), ...)` (typed values computed in code; they win over classes), `Key(id)`, `ID`, `For`, `Disabled(bool)`, `TabIndex`, `AutoFocus`, `Ref(elementRef)`, `TestID`, `Dir("rtl")`, `Scheme(tela.Dark)` (a subtree in another color scheme), `Inert`, `Href`, `Alt`, `Tint(color)`; text fields: `Value`, `DefaultValue`, `Bind(text, setText)`, `BindValue(*tela.Value[string])`, `Placeholder`, `Type("email")`, `Rows`, `ReadOnly`, `MaxLength`, `Name`; accessibility: `Role`, `AriaLabel`, `AriaLabelledBy`, `AriaCurrent("page")`, `AriaChecked`, `AriaExpanded`... (recipe accessibility); animation: `AnimateLayout()`, `LayoutID(id)`, `Exit(classes)`.

**Events:** `OnClick`, `OnDoubleClick`, `OnContextMenu`, `OnMouseDown/Up/Move/Enter/Leave`, `OnPointer...`, `OnLongPress`, `OnDrag`/`OnDragStart`/`OnDragEnd` (the drag gesture), `OnDragEnter`/`OnDragOver`/`OnDragLeave`/`OnDrop` with `Draggable(true)` (HTML's drag and drop: recipe desktop-integration), `OnWheel`, `OnScroll`, `OnKeyDown`/`OnKeyUp`, `OnFocus`/`OnBlur`, `OnChange` (every edit), `OnBeforeInput`, `OnSubmit`, `OnSelect`. Each takes a `func()` or a `func(e)` of its event type (`tela.MouseEvent`, `tela.KeyboardEvent`, `tela.ChangeEvent`...). Events bubble; `e.StopPropagation()`, `e.PreventDefault()`, or wrap a `func()` in `tela.StopPropagation(f)`. `e.CmdOrCtrl()` is Cmd on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere.

**Helpers:** `If(cond, child)` and `IfElse(cond, a, b)` take and return a `tela.Child` (a node, a struct component or a prop); the branch that is off is `nil`, the empty node (a hole that keeps the positions of its siblings; test it with `n == nil`); `Map(items, func(T) tela.Node)` and `MapIndex` (give each node a `Key`); `MapKeyed(items, keyFn, func(T) tela.Node)` keys the nodes for you; `Range(n, func(int) tela.Node)` for static repeats; `Nodes([]tela.Node)` passes a slice built in a loop. Every argument of `If` is evaluated: `If(u != nil, Text(u.Name))` panics on nil `u`; use a Go `if`. Examples of a keyed list, a shortcut, a raw text field and `VirtualList` (builds only the visible rows; it is the scroll container): recipe components.

## Components and hooks

**Struct components** are the default: the fields are the props, `Build` has a value receiver, children are a field of type `tela.Component` (several via `Fragment(...)`). A struct component is a `tela.Node`: return it from any function or `Build`, pass it to `If`, `Map`, `tela.C` and `Root`, and use it as a child, with no wrapper. It is its own component, with its own state, and its build is skipped while its fields are `==` to the previous ones (func or slice fields make it rebuild every time; that is fine). Never call `Card{...}.Build()`: its hooks would run in the caller.

**Function components** use `tela.C(fn)` (no props) or `tela.CP(fn, props)` (comparable props, skipped while `==`). Write the wrap once in a public function (`func Clock() tela.Node { return tela.C(clock) }`), so callers never call the private one. Keys: an element takes `Key(id)`; a component is keyed with `tela.WithKey(Card{...}, id)`, `tela.C(fn, Key(id))` or `MapKeyed`.

**Hooks** (at the top of a component, same order every build, never in `if`/`for`/after an early `return`/inside callbacks or `Map` functions; `tela lint` and dev mode say where):

| Hook | Does |
|---|---|
| `v, set := tela.UseState(init)` | State; `set.Set(v)`, `set.Update(func(T) T)` (use `Update` when the new value depends on the old). `set` is a comparable `tela.Setter[T]`, safe from any goroutine; `tela.Toggle(set)` flips a bool |
| `s, d := tela.UseReducer(reduce, init)` | `d.Dispatch(action)`; reducer `func(S, A) S` |
| `tela.UseEffect(f, deps...)` | After the frame is presented; `f` returns a cleanup or nil. No deps: every build; `tela.Once`: mount only. `tela.UseMount(f)`, `UseEffectDo`, `UseUpdateEffect` are variants |
| `tela.UseLayoutEffect(f, deps...)` | After layout, before paint: measure, scroll into view (the frame is painted scrolled) |
| `tela.UseMemo(compute, deps...)`, `tela.UseOnce(init)`, `tela.UseCallback(fn)` | Cached value; computed once; a stable comparable `tela.Callback[F]` (call `cb.Fn()`) |
| `r := tela.UseRef(init)` | `r.Current` persists, no rebuild |
| `el := tela.UseElementRef()` + `Ref(el)` | `el.Focus()`, `Blur`, `Click`, `Bounds()`, `ScrollTo/ScrollBy`, `ScrollIntoView()`, `ScrollToIndex(i, tela.AlignEnd)`, `Value()`, `Select()` |
| `tela.UseID()` | A stable unique id (label `For` + input `ID`) |
| `ctx := tela.CreateContext(def)` (package level), `ctx.Provider(v, children...)`, `tela.UseContext(ctx)` | Context; only readers rebuild |
| `v := tela.UseValue(init)` | Observable value: `v.Get()` in build rebuilds; read in a `...Fn` style prop (`tela.WidthFn`, `TranslateFn`, `OpacityFn`, `BgFn`...) or `TextFn` it only relayouts/repaints (recipe animation). `v.Set` from any goroutine |
| `tela.UseInterval(d, f)`, `tela.UseTimeout(d, f, deps...)` | On the frame clock, no goroutine. `d <= 0` pauses/cancels |
| `tela.UseGo(func(ctx context.Context), deps...)` | Background goroutine, cancelled when deps change or on unmount; update the UI through setters |
| `tela.UseSpring(target, opts...)`, `tela.UseTween(target, opts...)` | A `*tela.Value[T]` that animates toward `target` (float32, Color, Point, Size, Rect) |
| `tela.UseColorScheme()`, `tela.UseTheme()`, `tela.UseDirection()`, `tela.UseReducedMotion()`, `tela.UseWindow()` | Environment; `tela.SetColorScheme(tela.Dark)` switches the app |
| `kit.UseToast()`, `kit.UseStyle()`, `i18n.UseT()` | `kit.ToastHandle` (under a `kit.Toaster`); the active kit recipe; translations (recipe i18n) |

A custom hook is a function named `UseXxx`/`useXxx` that calls hooks. `tela.Post(f)` runs `f` on the UI thread from any goroutine. Reducers, a context, scrolling to the newest item, struct and function component examples: recipe components.

## Styling

Classes are Tailwind CSS v4's, verbatim, parsed into typed styles. If you would write it in React + Tailwind v4, write the same here. Order: element defaults, then classes in order (a later class wins over an earlier one that sets the same property; `Class` may repeat and takes several strings), then `Style(...)` props. No cascade, no selectors, no stylesheet. Everything is `border-box`. `Div` is `display: block`, like HTML.

**Supported:** spacing, sizing (`w-64`, `max-w-3xl`, `min-h-screen`, `size-8`, `h-[72px]`, `aspect-video`), flex and grid (`flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-1 shrink-0`, `grid grid-cols-3 col-span-2`), positioning (`relative absolute fixed sticky inset-0 z-10`), overflow (`overflow-y-auto`), colors with opacity (`bg-white/15`, `text-zinc-500`, `bg-[#1e1e2e]`), borders, `rounded-*`, `divide-y`, `ring-*`, `outline-*`, shadows, gradients (`bg-linear-to-br from-indigo-500 to-pink-500`), typography (`text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight truncate line-clamp-2 tabular-nums font-mono`), effects (`opacity-50 blur-sm backdrop-blur`), 2D transforms, transitions and `animate-*`, `cursor-pointer`, `pointer-events-none`, `select-none`, `sr-only`, arbitrary values (`w-[calc(50%-8px)]`, `grid-cols-[200px_1fr]`, with the theme's variables: `bg-(--color-primary)`). Units: `px rem em % vw vh fr ch`; `rem` follows the system's text scale.

**Variants** stack (`dark:md:hover:bg-zinc-800`): state (`hover: active: focus: focus-visible: focus-within: disabled: checked: placeholder: invalid: selection:`), ARIA (`aria-checked: aria-selected: aria-expanded: aria-pressed: aria-invalid: aria-disabled:`, `aria-[current=page]:`; they match the element's own `h.Aria...(true)` prop), structure (`first: last: odd: even:`, `group` + `group-hover:`, `peer` + `peer-checked:`), environment (`dark:`, `sm: md: lg: xl: 2xl:`, `max-md:`, `motion-reduce:`, `contrast-more:`, `rtl:`, `starting:` for entrances).

**Theme tokens** (shadcn/ui names) work in every color utility (`bg-`, `text-`, `border-`, `ring-`, `from-`...), with opacity (`bg-primary/90`) and variants, and follow the color scheme by themselves: no `dark:` pairs needed. Tokens: `background`, `foreground`, `card`, `popover`, `primary`, `secondary`, `muted`, `accent` (each with `-foreground`), `destructive`, `border`, `input`, `ring`, `chart-1`..`chart-5`. Palette colors (`bg-zinc-900`) do not follow the scheme: pair them with `dark:`. `kit.Theme()` is shadcn's neutral theme with its 10 px radius; a brand theme, `ClassAliases`, colors in Go (`tela.Hex`, `tela.OKLCH`), fonts (`tela.App{Fonts: ...}`; tests and snapshots use bundled fonts, never the system's) and the full list of what is not implemented are in the recipe styling.

**Icons:** `Icon(lucide.Settings, Class("size-4"))`: 1em square unless sized, colored by the text color, decorative unless it has an `AriaLabel`. Lucide names are the file names of lucide.dev in PascalCase (`arrow-up-right` is `lucide.ArrowUpRight`); to check one, `go doc github.com/kuronosu/tela/icons/lucide CircleAlert`. Your own SVGs: `tela.Icon{SVG: "<svg ...>"}` or `tela icons gen`.

**Not implemented** (a dev error says what to use): floats, margin collapsing, `display: table` (use `kit.Table` or grid), `before:`/`after:`, `data-*:`, `has-*:`, `@container`, CSS variables other than the theme's, arbitrary properties other than `[clip-path:...]` and `[animation-delay:...]`, 3D transforms, `scroll-snap`, custom `@keyframes`.

## kit

`kit` has 39 components with shadcn/ui's ("new-york-v4") look, built on the `aria` behavior hooks: keyboard, focus and roles are done. Use them for every control; build layout and decoration with `h` elements and classes around them. Components: `kit.Button`, `Badge`, `Alert`, `Card`, `Avatar`, `AvatarGroup`, `Separator`, `Skeleton`, `Markdown`, `Label`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `Field`, `FieldSet`, `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `RadioGroup`, `Toggle`, `ToggleGroup`, `Slider`, `Progress`, `Select`, `Tabs`, `Table`, `Dialog`, `AlertDialog`, `Popover`, `TitleBar`, `WindowControls`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, `ContextMenu`, `Menubar`, `Toaster`, `Calendar`, `RangeCalendar`, `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `ColorPicker`, `ColorInput`, `StyleProvider`. There is no `kit.Sheet`, `Accordion`, `Breadcrumb`, `Sidebar` or `Combobox`: compose them from `Div`s, `kit.Dialog`, `kit.Popover`, `aria.UseCombobox`. The recipe kit has the fields of each, forms, overlays, tables, toasts and customization; recipe settings-screen is a whole screen to copy.

**Rules that hold for every component:**
- Each is a struct; its fields are its props. `Class` adds classes to the root after the component's own (last wins); parts have `...Class` fields. `Props` takes one more `h` prop for the root (`Props: TestID("save")`).
- Content is `Children tela.Component`; multi-part components have slots (`kit.Card{Title, Description, Action, Children, Footer}`). A kit component is a `tela.Node`: return it as it is.
- Values: controlled `Value *T` + `OnValueChange func(T)` (`Checked *bool` + `OnCheckedChange`, `Open *bool` + `OnOpenChange`), or uncontrolled `DefaultValue`/`DefaultChecked`/`DefaultOpen`. Choices among keys are generic: `kit.Select[string]`, `DefaultValue: new("pro")`.
- `Variant`: `kit.Default` (zero), `kit.Secondary`, `kit.Outline`, `kit.Ghost`, `kit.Destructive`, `kit.Link`. `Size`: empty is the default size, then `kit.Xs`, `kit.Sm`, `kit.Lg`, and for icon-only buttons `kit.Icon`. An undefined variant or size panics in dev mode with the valid ones.
- Overlays (`Dialog`, `AlertDialog`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, menus) take a `Trigger`: a `kit.Button{...}`, or any element through `kit.TriggerFunc`. Customize: theme tokens first, then `kit.StyleProvider` recipes, then `Class`. A form card with fields, errors and a submit is in the recipe kit.

## Testing

`telatest` mounts a component in a headless window, drives it with real events, finds elements like Playwright and compares goldens (`testdata/<name>.png`; `TELA_UPDATE=1 go test ./...` writes them). Dev errors fail the test. Expectations wait for frames, animations and `UseAsync` runs to settle; the clock is manual (`app.Advance(d)`).

```go
func TestCounterLike(t *testing.T) {
	app := telatest.MountFunc(t, func() tela.Node {
		n, setN := tela.UseState(0)
		return Div(Class("p-6"), kit.Button{Children: Text("Add"), OnClick: func() { setN.Update(func(n int) int { return n + 1 }) }}, Textf("n=%d", n))
	}, telatest.Size(320, 120), telatest.Theme(kit.Theme()))
	app.Click(telatest.ByRole("button", "Add"))
	app.ExpectText("n=1")
	app.ExpectAccessible() // names, roles, contrast, target sizes
	app.Golden("add.png")  // look at the PNG
}
```

`telatest.Mount(t, comp, opts...)`, `MountApp(t, App, opts...)`; locators `ByRole(role, name)`, `ByText`, `ByTestID`, `ByClass`; `app.Expect(loc, telatest.Checked(true), ...)`, `ExpectText`, `ExpectCount`, `ExpectAria(yaml)`, `ExpectIdle()`. Windows, desktop services, modifiers, `HasRange`, audits: recipes testing, windows and desktop-integration.

## Recipes

Recipes sit beside this file in `llms/`: `https://telaui.dev/llms/<name>.md`, or in a project `$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/kuronosu/tela)/docs/llms/<name>.md`. Read one when your task touches its area; each starts with the questions it answers. `https://telaui.dev/llms-full.txt` is this file and every recipe in one.

- [kit](llms/kit.md): the fields of every kit component, forms with errors, radio cards, selects, dialogs, menus, tables, toasts, calendars, customizing kit's look.
- [settings-screen](llms/settings-screen.md): a whole settings screen to copy: sidebar shell, cards of switch rows, radio cards, select, Save with a toast.
- [components](llms/components.md): struct and function components in depth, keyed lists, `VirtualList`, shortcuts, raw text fields, reducers and contexts, scroll to newest.
- [styling](llms/styling.md): every supported class and variant with samples, what is not implemented, brand themes, aliases, colors in Go, fonts, icons.
- [animation](llms/animation.md): transitions, springs and tweens, drawers, enter and exit, layout animations, animated gradients, looking at motion.
- [windows](llms/windows.md): second windows, closing and hiding, custom title bars, transparent windows and backdrops, file dialogs, message boxes, notifications, tray, saved settings and window placement.
- [desktop-integration](llms/desktop-integration.md): drag and drop, clipboard, global shortcuts, launches, links and file types, keyring secrets, trash, native menus, system contrast, text scale, accent.
- [testing](llms/testing.md): `telatest` in full: locators, expectations, goldens, the clock, modifiers, idle checks, accessibility and layout audits.
- [accessibility](llms/accessibility.md): roles, names and aria props, keyboard and focus, access keys, high contrast, `tela check` and `tela verify`.
- [i18n](llms/i18n.md): translating, plurals, number, currency and date formatting, number skeletons, Tela's own texts, RTL, testing a locale.
- [dev](llms/dev.md): `tela dev` reloads and kept state, `--debug` with Delve, DevTools, attaching an agent, `tela run` and `tela build`.

## 9. Pitfalls and limits

| Mistake | Fix |
|---|---|
| `Div("Hello")` does not compile | `Div(Text("Hello"))`; formatted: `Textf("%d", n)` |
| Calling a function component that uses hooks: `counter()`, `telatest.Mount(t, counter())`, `Card{}.Build()` (dev mode panics: "hook called outside its component") | `tela.C(counter)` (write a public `Counter()` that returns it once), `tela.CP(fn, props)`, or pass the struct value itself: `Card{}` |
| A hook inside `if`, a loop, a `Map`/`VirtualList` callback, an event handler, or after an early `return` | Call every hook at the top of the component; move per-row state into a row component (`MapKeyed(items, key, func(T) tela.Component { return Row{...} })`) |
| Returning a prop where a node is expected: `return Class("p-4")`, or a `Map` callback that returns `Key(x.ID)` (it compiles, because a prop has a `Build` method, and panics in dev mode; `tela lint` reports `prop-node`) | Props go to an element: `Div(Class("p-4"), ...)`, `Div(Key(x.ID), ...)` |
| `Fragment(kit.Button{...})`, `Fragment(x)` around a single node, or `tela.Node{}` / `n.IsZero()` for the empty node (removed) | `kit.Button{...}`, `x`, `nil` / `n == nil`; `tela lint -fix` removes the single-child `Fragment`s |
| A list from `Map` without keys (dev warning "list without keys"), or index keys on a list that reorders | `Key(item.ID)` on each element; `tela.WithKey(comp, id)` for components; `MapKeyed` |
| Declaring a name that `h` exports in your package (`Button`, `Label`, `Input`, `Text`, `Icon`, `Form`, `Value`, `Name`, `Type`, `Key`, `Map`, `Range`, `Scale`, `Style`, `Rows`, `ID`, `P`, `A`, `Code`...): "already declared through dot-import" | Name it `SaveButton`, `FieldLabel`, `themes`... |
| `&Card{}` as a child, or a prop in a `tela.Component` field (`Children: Class("p-4")`): dev panic | Pass `Card{}`; put props in `Class`/`Props` |
| `setCount.Set(count + 1)` twice in one frame loses one | `setCount.Update(func(n int) int { return n + 1 })`; `tela.Toggle(setOpen)` for bools |
| `UseEffect(f, nil)` (dev panic) | `tela.UseEffect(f, tela.Once)` or `tela.UseMount(f)` |
| Unknown or misspelled class (`rounded-xxl`, `bg-primry`) | Dev error with "did you mean"; `tela lint ./...` finds them statically. Unsupported classes say what to use |
| A `kit.Tooltip` on a wrapper around a `kit.DropdownMenu` | Nest them: `kit.Tooltip{Content: Text("More"), Trigger: kit.DropdownMenu[string]{Trigger: kit.Button{...}}}` |
| `kit.Field` around `h.Input`, around two controls, or around an overlay trigger (`AlertDialog`, `Dialog`, `Popover`): the label names nothing or the wrong one | One kit control per `Field` (`kit.Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `DatePicker`, `ColorInput`); a label + button row is a `Div` (`SignOutRow` above); `RadioGroup`/`ToggleGroup` go in a `kit.FieldSet` (legend names them) or take `AriaLabel`; `Slider` and `Progress` take `AriaLabel` |
| Scrolling to the newest item flickers or lands short | `UseLayoutEffect` + `ref.ScrollIntoView()` (or `ScrollToIndex(i, tela.AlignEnd)` on a `VirtualList`), deps = the item count |
| A flex child does not scroll or overflows | Give the scroll container a definite height (`h-screen`, `flex-1 min-h-0` in a `flex-col`, `h-96`) and `overflow-y-auto`; `min-w-0` on flex children that hold truncated text |
| Wanting `kit.Sheet`, `kit.Accordion`, `kit.Breadcrumb`, `kit.Sidebar`, `kit.Combobox` | Not in kit: compose `Div`s with tokens (a `Div` sidebar with `AriaCurrent`), or use `kit.Dialog`/`kit.Popover`; `aria` has `UseCombobox` for a hand-built one |
| `Variant: "primary"` on a `kit.Button` | The default variant is the zero value; variants are `Secondary`, `Outline`, `Ghost`, `Destructive`, `Link` |
| `tela snapshot --dark` still renders light (or the other way round), or every render has one scheme | `App.ColorScheme` is set to `tela.Light`/`tela.Dark` and overrides the flag: leave it `tela.System` |
| A kit page that looks off (square corners, wrong colors) | `Theme: &theme` (`theme := kit.Theme()`) and `RootClass: "bg-background text-foreground"` |
| Palette colors that ignore dark mode (`bg-white`, `text-zinc-900`) | Tokens (`bg-card`, `text-foreground`), or add `dark:` pairs |
| The snapshot does not show a toast or effect result | `tela snapshot` renders one frame; in `tela mcp`, act then `wait {"ms": 300}` and `screenshot` |
| `Div(Class("flex"), children...)` with a `[]tela.Node` slice: Go cannot spread it | `Div(Class("flex"), Nodes(children))` |
| A `tela.Window` without `OnClose`: its close button does nothing | `OnClose: func() { setOpen.Set(false) }`: state owns whether a window exists |
| `desktop.OpenFile`, `ShowMessage` or `Notify` from a goroutine (dev panic), or state set in the callback of a goroutine | Call them from handlers and effects, or inside `tela.Post(func() { ... })`; their callbacks run on the UI thread |
| `App.OnClose` hides the window but nothing can show it again (no tray, or the tray is unsupported) | Pair it with a `desktop.Tray` whose `OnError` turns the hiding off; `tela.Quit` from the menu |
| `kit.TitleBar` in a window that keeps the OS's title bar: two bars | `Frameless: true`, or draw it only when `tela.UseWindow().State().ClientSideDecorations` |
| A test reads or writes the real settings and window placements | `telatest.TempDesktopDirs(t)` at its start |
| A drop zone never gets `OnDrop`, or flickers while the drag moves over its children | Call `e.PreventDefault()` in `OnDragOver`; count enters and leaves (the new element's enter comes before the old one's leave) instead of a bool |
| `desktop.Secret`/`SetSecret` in a handler, an effect or a build (dev warning; the keyring may wait for the user, so the app freezes) | A goroutine (`go func() {...}()` or `tela.UseGo`) that sets state with a `Setter`; handle `ErrSecretCanceled` and `ErrUnsupported` |
| `desktop.Register` for a link or file type, then expecting it to be the default or to replace another app's | It makes the app a candidate only. `MakeDefault` on the user's request; `Replace()` only after asking; under `go run`/`tela dev` give `ForApp(HandlerApp{Exec: ...})` |
| A `GlobalShortcut` that "does nothing" | Show `OnStatus`: it may be taken, refused by the user, or unsupported; a nil `OnStatus` only warns in dev mode |

**Limits.** Linux (Wayland, X11), Windows and macOS 13+. Wayland cannot place windows or keep them on top, and Windows notifications have no action buttons; a tray needs a host on Linux (GNOME needs an extension). `Checkbox` has no indeterminate state; `Select` has no search (build a combobox with `aria.UseCombobox`); `Table` is virtual only with a fixed `RowHeight`, and has no column resizing or row selection UI; no date-time input; no `tela add` yet. No margin collapsing, floats or CSS tables; 2D transforms only; SVG icons have no text, filters or patterns; no `grid-template-areas` from classes; `vertical-align` only on inline-blocks.
